recommendations.name: Sawarin Sriyathep
paragraphs: I had a great experience working with Insan on various projects. He’s not only a reliable UX/UI designer but also someone who always brings a positive and collaborative spirit to the team.

What I appreciated most is how he really listens to the business needs, turning complex ideas into a user-friendly designs. His willingness to work across teams made it easy to push projects forward smoothly.
I also admire how open he is to feedback and how much he supports the people around him. Any team would be lucky to have Insan on board — both as a designer and as a teammate.

recommendations.name: Adi Ritonga
paragraphs: Insan is one of those rare designers who consistently performs beyond expectations—not just in my view, but also unanimously acknowledged by his team. Throughout our time working together, he collaborated closely with engineers, QA, and PMs on a daily basis, making him an essential part of cross-functional execution. He led critical improvements across AccelByte Gaming Services, especially in self-service features like Billing and Usage, the Pricing page, Pricing calculator, Homepage, and many more.

Insan has excellent communication skills and always articulates his design decisions with clarity and confidence. He’s also a strong partner in brainstorming, often bringing fresh perspectives to the table.
Beyond design, he proactively provides feedback and continuously improves team workflows and communication, helping everyone collaborate more effectively. A truly valuable team member!

recommendations.name: Bonie Rimba Celebica
paragraphs: What I like about Insan is that he always being critical in every project that he handled. He shown that a UI designer is not only contributed to all the visual stuff.
Another point, Insan never stop learning. He listen to feedbacks and always work to improve himself. I believe Insan will go far in his career.

recommendations.name: Utari Ambarwati
recommendations.relationship: Mentor, as described in the recommendation
paragraphs: During Tokopedia Product Design Academy program that had been running for 9 months (April - December 2021). As his mentor, I found him to be consistently growing, a fast learner, a highly initiative, and an independent UI Designer. He tackled all assigned tasks with dedication and smiles.

Insan's first project was helping User Account Tribe for 3 months. His communication, UI explorations and animations really helped the team to get things done. The special thing was he also did proper competitive research and validated his design to users independently while his main job as UI Designer was to visualize the product. In the next 3 months till the end of the program, Insan was in charge of IT Enterprise Tribe handling projects that related to Finance and Campaign/Advertising Solutions. Here, Insan was facing more challenges: more stakeholders, unsettled business and product requirements, and handling end-to-end processes (UX, UI, UT, Design Handoff to Developers, QA Design before release, Iterations). With a little guidance and feedback, he made it quite well. What I like about him, he was open to any feedback, passionate to learn things, collaborative and those good things reflected in his visual design output, neat documentation, and effective collaboration.

I endorse Insan’s ability to clarify unsettled product requirements, define the use cases, create a good experience based on user needs, make clear and creative illustration and animation, validate the design, detail-oriented, explorative, which was also supported by his great soft skills. I believe that Insan will be a good team player and make impacts in his future company.
